 Team news: Republic of Ireland defensive trio back in starting XI in Linz with Finn Azaz in deeper role
 Updated / Saturday, 14 Nov 2026
 19:09
 Finn Azaz will join Jayson Molumby in front of the back five 
 Raf Diallo
 By Raf Diallo in Raiffeisen Arena, Linz
 RTÉ Sport Journalist
 The defensive trio of Nathan Collins, Dara O'Shea and James Abankwah have returned to the starting line-up, while Finn Azaz has been entrusted with a deeper midfield role for the Republic of Ireland's UEFA Nations League clash against Austria in Linz.
 Collins was unavailable for all four of the Boys in Green's fixtures in September and October due to a calf injury but is back to captain Heimir Hallgrimsson's side from the centre of the back five at the Raiffeisen Arena.
 O'Shea, who missed the 1-1 draw against Israel in Serbia on 4 October becuase of the impending birth of his second child, is also back in the side, while James Abankwah slots in at right wing-back having been suspended for that fixture.
 Ryan Manning starts in the opposite wing back slot, with Liam Scales just inside on the left of a back three in front of goalkeeper Caoimhin Kelleher.
 Troy Parrott arrives at the stadium with Séamus Coleman who is with the squad in a hybrid role but is not included from a playing point of view tonight 
 Meanwhile, attacking midfielder Azaz will reprise the deeper midfield role he was deployed in for the home game against Austria last month. The Southampton playmaker will be partnered by Jayson Molumby.
 In a repeat of Ireland's two most recent fixtures against Austria and Israel, Jack Moylan and Adam Idah will play support roles behind centre-forward Troy Parrott.
 'We' want to be on the front foot and try to surprise them at the beginning. Don't tell anyone.' Heimir Hallgrimsson talks @corktod through his attacking team selection 📺Watch Austria v Ireland live on RTÉ2 and RTÉ Player from 7pm https://t.co/HUO21NEYby
— RTÉ Sport (@RTEsport) November 14, 2026 
 Earlier on Saturday afternoon, Jimmy Dunne was confirmed as the only squad member not included in the matchday 23, while Hallgrimsson had confirmed the previous day that Séamus Coleman - who is fulfilling a hybrid training player-coach role would not be called upon.
 Molumby, Manning, Scales, Idah and Conor Coventry go into the game on yellow cards.
 Injury-hit Austria, meanwhile, have made four changes to the side that drew 1-1 with Kosovo in their last game with Philipp Lienhart, Philipp Mwene, Christoph Lang and RB Leipzig midfielder Christoph Baumgartner coming into their team. Bayern Munich's Konrad Laimer will captain Ralf Rangnick's outfit.
 Austria: Alexander Schlager; Stefan Posch, Philipp Lienhart, Kevin Danso, Philipp Mwene; Konrad Laimer (c), Christoph Baumgartner, Nicolas Seiwald; Romano Schmid, Christoph Lang; Michael Gregoritsch.
 Republic of Ireland: Caoimhin Kelleher; Dara O'Shea, Nathan Collins (c), Liam Scales; James Abankwah, Ryan Manning; Jayson Molumby, Finn Azaz; Jack Moylan, Adam Idah; Troy Parrott.
 Referee: Irfan Peljto (Bosnia & Herzegovina)
 Watch Austria v Republic of Ireland in the UEFA Nations League on Saturday from 7pm on RTÉ2 and RTÉ Player. Follow our live blog on RTÉ.ie/sport and RTÉ News app and listen to live commentary on Saturday Sport on RTÉ Radio 1
